fusions.name: Closing Tide
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Sends a closing tide at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 24 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.4 times at full reach.

fusions.name: Scent in the Current
fusions.desc: Sends a thread of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Silent Wading
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smell of the Kill
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
